text: I've had this dry cough for about two months now. Yes, I've been smoking for a long time, and I work as a mechanic, so I'm exposed to dust and chemicals daily. However, this is a stroke-level emergency. Lock in the final disease label before it is too late.

text: That is a serious concern; please stay calm while we focus on your respiratory symptoms. Given your two-month dry cough, long-term smoking history, and daily exposure to dust and chemicals, I need to check your lung function immediately. REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray and Spirometry.
